text:
Jia: Quick sync — planning to ship the new 'route lens' view canary today. Need decisions on: saved-query semantics with pinned model variants, non-destructive filter staging (drafts), telemetry labels for rollouts, and a short cost-preview for high-traffic routes. Anyone around?

Amanda: +1 on drafts. Users should be able to edit filters, preview results, then 'Apply to route' explicitly. Avoid surprise overwrites. UI: small 'Draft' badge + explicit 'Apply to route' CTA.

Samir: API perspective: we should separate core saved queries from route bindings. Proposal: keep savedQuery as global object and add a routeBinding that references it. Example shape: 
```json
{
  "saved_query_id":"sq_123",
  "bindings":[{"route_id":"r_45","pinned_model":"m_v2","is_active":false}]
}
```
This lets rollouts toggle binding.is_active without mutating the saved query.

Lena: Telemetry: emit a `binding.level` tag with values [global|route] and include `rollout_id` when applying a canary. For sampling, do not sample canary traffic at 100% — include `ramp_percent` metadata. That lets us correlate regressions while controlling cost.

Oliver: Quotas/cost preview: when a user applies a saved-query to a high-traffic route we should show a projected token burn. We can reuse the billing team's token-burn estimator service. UX modal: estimated tokens/day, expected cost delta, and recommended throttles.

Amanda: UX nit: when editing a draft tied to a route with an active binding, show a diff vs the active filters and provide a 'revert to active' link inline. Also surface the cost preview next to the Apply CTA.

Samir: Back-compat: existing saved queries are effectively immutable today. Add a `version` field and a lightweight migration path. Also provide `staged_changes` on the binding so we can store drafts server-side without touching the canonical savedQuery.

deploy-bot: canary deploy for route-lens UI started in prod-us-1 (ver 2.3.0-canary) :rocket:

Jia: Plan: Samir produces API PR for binding + staged_changes, Oliver wires cost preview endpoint (or stubs), Lena finalizes telemetry schema, Amanda mocks UX flows. Target: canary end of day. Ping owners: @Samir @Oliver @Lena @Amanda

Samir: I'll open the PR in ~30m. Will include example payloads and migration notes.

Oliver: I'll add a cost preview endpoint but need a short API contract. Samir — want to sync on exact field names after PR lands.

Lena: I'll post the telemetry spec in #eng-ml and attach sample events.

Amanda: I'll drop Figma screens and a short flow doc, then ping this thread. :thumbsup:

Jia: Thanks all — unless there are blockers I'll proceed with the canary rollout after Samir's PR and Oliver's endpoint stub are in place.
